Once you have identified potential clients, you will classify, segment and prioritize them in line with the sales plan and budget. You will contact potential customers to give business presentations and software demonstrations. You will manage these opportunities as they become customers in the pipeline (RFPs, RFIs, RFQs and bids), negotiating contracts, MSAs, SOWs and closing deals with them. With respect to your existing customers (your portfolio), you will be responsible for continuing to expand the value of EDICOM’s solutions , holding presentations and demonstrations as part of our cross-selling strategy, as well as following up and closing the sale of new services. Company benefits (medical insurance, gym, sports and team building activities, language training, parking facilities…). If you are attracted by the challenge and believe you can take our sales strategy to another level, sign up for the offer and join EDICOM.

review_candidates.title: Industrial Localization Lead
review_candidates.description: Role Purpose The Industrial Localization Lead is a technical role responsible for identifying, assessing and enabling industrial and manufacturing localization opportunities across Energy Oman and its subsidiaries. The role determines whether targeted products, equipment, materials and industrial services can be manufactured, assembled, tested, refurbished or serviced in Oman, and defines the technical capabilities required to achieve sustainable local production. The role leads engineering and manufacturing assessments covering production processes, materials, technology, facilities, machinery, tooling, testing, quality systems, technical skills and compliance with applicable international and operator standards. It works closely with engineering, operations, quality, procurement, international manufacturers, technology providers, local manufacturers and government stakeholders to progress technically viable opportunities from initial assessment through qualification and first local production. 2. Key Responsibilities Technical Localization Assessment & Planning Technical Localization Screening: Assess products, equipment, materials and industrial services to determine their technical suitability for localization in Oman. Manufacturing Feasibility: Evaluate whether identified opportunities can be locally manufactured, assembled, tested, refurbished or serviced using existing or achievable technical capabilities. Engineering Review: Review drawings, specifications, bills of materials, material requirements, operating conditions and performance criteria to define localization requirements. Localization Roadmaps: Develop technical localization roadmaps outlining required capabilities, qualification stages, key risks, dependencies and milestones from concept to first local production. Technical Prioritization: Provide engineering-based recommendations on the readiness, complexity, technical risk and implementation requirements of localization opportunities. Manufacturing Process & Facility Assessment Manufacturing Process Evaluation: Assess required processes including machining, fabrication, welding, forging, casting, heat treatment, coating, assembly, inspection and testing. Facility Capability Assessment: Evaluate existing and proposed facilities for technical readiness, process capability, equipment suitability, capacity, layout, utilities and production controls. Machinery & Tooling Requirements: Define the production machinery, tooling, fixtures, software, laboratories and testing equipment required for local manufacturing. Production Readiness: Assess whether manufacturers have adequate procedures, competent personnel, maintenance systems, material controls and production planning arrangements. Technical Gap Analysis: Identify gaps in infrastructure, technology, processes, equipment, workforce competence, quality systems and supporting industrial services, and recommend corrective actions.
